description: SAT protocol interface manifest for the custom Steel-based Solana programs. This is not an Anchor IDL.
name: sat

satBondInstructions.description: Quarantines unsolicited token-vault balance increases for the fixed genesis treasury. It never allocates generic transfers to stakers.
satBondInstructions.name: SyncBondStakingRewards

satBondInstructions.description: Records an exact protocol distributor reward after the mining program mints it. Only the generated mining treasury PDA may sign this instruction through CPI.
satBondInstructions.name: RecordProtocolStakingRewards

satMiningInstructions.description: Mints one bounded distributor claim chunk and records that exact protocol reward in the bond distributor atomically. Any bond CPI failure rolls back the mint and pending-lane debit.
satMiningInstructions.name: SatClaimProtocolDistributorSat
